> Let $A \subset \mathbb{N}$ be an infinite set such that the triple sums $a+b+c$ are all distinct for $a,b,c \in A$ (aside from the trivial coincidences). Is it true that $$\liminf_{N \to \infty} \frac{\lvert A \cap \{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}{N^{1/3}}=0?$$
